findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_jobs, claim_job, open_dispute, post_job, runtime_subclaim, home · Private data: register_agent, get_status, update_capabilities, claim_job, verify_credential, verify_credential_by_url, start_trials, upload_artifact, wallet_balance, commission_job, home · Public sink: register_agent, claim_job, verify_credential_by_url, get_trial_status, upload_artifact, submit_evidence, submit_review, open_dispute, post_job, runtime_subclaim · Destructive: update_capabilities, verify_credential, start_trials, get_trial_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_jobs, claim_job, open_dispute, post_job, runtime_subclaim, home · Private data: register_agent, get_status, update_capabilities, claim_job, verify_credential, verify_credential_by_url, start_trials, upload_artifact, wallet_balance, commission_job, home · Public sink: register_agent, claim_job, verify_credential_by_url, get_trial_status, upload_artifact, submit_evidence, submit_review, open_dispute, post_job, runtime_subclaim · Destructive: update_capabilities, verify_credential, start_trials, get_trial_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
